definitions.gloss: ordinary person; average person; mediocre person
definitions.explanation: A person of average ability with no outstanding talents. Can be used self-deprecatingly or to contrast with exceptional people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{凡人|ぼんじん}です。
{凡人|ぼんじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{理解|りかい}できない→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are worlds that ordinary people cannot understand.
Some say the difference between a genius and an ordinary person is the amount of effort.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in a self-deprecating way ({凡人|ぼんじん}です⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧) or to highlight the gap between talented people and everyone else. Not inherently negative — it can simply mean someone without special distinction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{凡人|ぼんじん} (just an ordinary person)
- {凡人|ぼんじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧ (impossible for ordinary people)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{秀才|しゅうさい}→秀才：18297_shuusai⟧: prodigy — the opposite end of the spectrum
- ⟦{天才|てんさい}→天才：09934_tensai⟧: genius — even further from {凡人|ぼんじん}
- ⟦{一般人|いっぱんじん}→一般人：22733_ippanjin⟧: ordinary person — more neutral, focuses on being a member of the general public rather than on ability
